checklist.evidence: The non-Git mirror, complete inventory, source/Git separation and bytecode removal remain present, but same-target append writes can still be lost and failed AGY executions are synchronized before rejection.

Runner/Sol repair routes use AGY and no Luna production dispatch was found, but ordinary criterion invalidation causes repeated Astra replanning, and exhausted replanning is not durably persisted as BLOCKED.

The public loop consumes the master plan and commits tasks in dependency order, but an independently valid three-task plan with disjoint criteria invoked Astra three times and ended with phase=planned after raising instead of COMPLETE or durable BLOCKED.
candidate_id uses git write-tree; review and commit gates bind base/tree/candidate state; mutation checks and exact pending-commit reconciliation remain present, with no concrete regression found.
Missing or invalid criterion evidence does not authorize COMPLETE; completion also checks pending candidate/commit state and unresolved ledger findings.
Active Aider/bridge/Luna production routes are removed, documentation reflects the current design, and all five staged SHA256SUMS entries independently matched their staged blobs.

No concrete regression was found in previously approved Steps 1-6 or resolved Step 7 findings. The exact full suite independently passed 136 tests and 39 subtests; git diff --cached --check passed and the staged tree contains no pyc or __pycache__ paths.

blocking_findings.contract_source: Authoritative plan Sections 2 and 5, Milestone 1 T1, required check 1, and prior STEP7-F002
blocking_findings.exact_requirement: AGY delta synchronization must stay bound to the reserved host candidate and must reject or preserve every same-target mutation through completion of replacement.
blocking_findings.concrete_evidence: In an isolated Windows temporary-repository probe against the staged module, the real ReplaceFileW call was wrapped to append CONCURRENT-APPEND to allowed.py after _replace_candidate_file's expected-target check but immediately before the OS replacement. The append succeeded, _sync_sandbox_candidate returned success, and final allowed.py was agy-content with the concurrent append lost.
blocking_findings.observed_state: The byte-range lock covers only the original file length and the handle permits FILE_SHARE_WRITE and FILE_SHARE_DELETE, so an append outside the locked range can succeed and then be discarded by replacement.
blocking_findings.expected_state: Synchronization must reject or preserve any host write occurring after reservation and before replacement completes; it must never report success after losing that write.
blocking_findings.why_it_blocks_current_step: The boundary can still destroy host-owned candidate work, so prior STEP7-F002 is not resolved.
blocking_findings.required_correction: Use a replacement/CAS primitive that excludes or detects all writes through replacement completion, including append and pre-existing handles, preserve rollback semantics, and add a regression that injects the write at the actual ReplaceFileW boundary and asserts reject-or-preserve.

blocking_findings.contract_source: Authoritative plan Sections 1, 5, 8 and 11, acceptance scenarios 1 and 8, remaining risk Completion evidence freshness, and prior STEP7-F013
blocking_findings.exact_requirement: Criterion freshness must be affected-lineage aware while a normal valid N-task project completes with exactly one Astra invocation.
blocking_findings.concrete_evidence: A temporary integration probe used a valid sequential T1/T2/T3 plan over disjoint f1.py, f2.py and f3.py, with independent G1/G2/G3 ownership and passing Runner/Sol results for all three commits. _invalidate_affected_criteria marked every prior criterion UNVERIFIED regardless of disjoint scope or dependency impact. After T3, G1 and G2 were UNVERIFIED, Astra had been invoked three times, and execute raised instead of completing. The shipped FakeRoles plan assigns the same G1 to every task, masking this valid distributed-criterion case.
blocking_findings.observed_state: Unconditional invalidation avoids one stale-evidence case by invalidating unaffected evidence too, turning ordinary execution into repeated replanning and breaking the Astra-once property.
blocking_findings.expected_state: Retain unaffected evidence, invalidate only criteria whose behavioral lineage may be affected, and refresh affected criteria with Runner/Sol evidence so a normal plan completes with Astra count one.
blocking_findings.why_it_blocks_current_step: The public loop fails a valid normal master plan and makes the central machine-verifiable quota property false.
blocking_findings.required_correction: Implement a fail-closed affected-criterion contract using explicit plan ownership/dependency or declared regression coverage rather than invalidating every prior criterion; add a disjoint-file distributed-criterion integration regression asserting COMPLETE and one Astra call.

blocking_findings.contract_source: Authoritative plan Sections 2, 3, 5 and 10, Milestone 1 T1, and required check 1
blocking_findings.exact_requirement: Only a successful, protocol-valid AGY attempt may yield an accepted atomic delta synchronized into the host-owned candidate.
blocking_findings.concrete_evidence: In an isolated sandbox-runner probe, the guest mirror changed allowed.py to failed-process-change and wrote completion evidence with exit_code 7. _run_windows_sandbox_builder called _sync_sandbox_candidate before checking exit_code, then raised BuilderProcessError with failure_code=agy_runtime_error; the host candidate nevertheless contained failed-process-change. Staged source lines 4300-4318 show synchronization precedes the nonzero-exit rejection, and outer AGY protocol validation also occurs only after this function returns.
blocking_findings.observed_state: Failed or malformed AGY attempts can mutate the host candidate before being rejected.
blocking_findings.expected_state: Nonzero exit, incomplete output, malformed protocol, wrong identity, or another failed attempt must discard the mirror without changing the host candidate; synchronization occurs only after full attempt acceptance.
blocking_findings.why_it_blocks_current_step: This weakens the AGY isolation and acceptance boundary and allows unaccepted writer output to affect later execution and release state.
blocking_findings.required_correction: Complete exit and AGY stream/identity validation before synchronization, discard failed mirrors, and add deterministic nonzero-exit and malformed-output regressions asserting the host candidate remains byte-identical.

blocking_findings.contract_source: Authoritative plan Sections 7, 10 and 11 and acceptance scenario 7
blocking_findings.exact_requirement: Non-convergence or exhausted automatic recovery must persist BLOCKED and must not silently refill a retry budget on the next execute or resume call.
blocking_findings.concrete_evidence: The same valid three-task probe reached the local replan_count greater-than-two branch after three Astra calls. _execute_locked raised FactoryError(category=blocked), but run_state remained phase=planned. replan_count is a local variable initialized to zero on every _execute_locked invocation, so a subsequent execute can repeat the same Astra calls instead of observing durable BLOCKED state.
blocking_findings.observed_state: Automatic replan exhaustion is not atomically recorded; the run remains resumable as planned and its retry count refills per invocation.
blocking_findings.expected_state: The terminal non-convergence branch must atomically persist phase=blocked with reason/evidence and a durable budget/history before raising; later resume must remain blocked absent an authorized resolution.
blocking_findings.why_it_blocks_current_step: State semantics and quota safety are false across process boundaries, permitting repeated strategy churn instead of fail-closed termination.
blocking_findings.required_correction: Persist BLOCKED and durable replan-attempt evidence before raising, ensure execute/resume cannot reset it, and add a repeated execute/resume regression proving no additional Astra call after the block.

No concrete regression found in conversation identity or step-update validation.

The exact staged tree contains no pyc or __pycache__ paths.
No concrete regression found in exact pending-commit reconciliation or post-approval mutation rejection.
Resume scans and validates bound orphan Sol review artifacts, honors REJECT before re-review, and uses the budgeted AGY repair loop; focused crash-boundary tests pass.
Every SHA256SUMS entry independently matched the corresponding exact staged blob.
No concrete regression found in preservation of completed commits and evidence across exceptional replanning.
Master-plan identifiers remain globally unique and criterion coverage is validated before dispatch.
Capability preflight no longer invokes the planner model; the sole initial planner-model call is the Astra master-plan call absent later exceptional replanning.
